title: Daily Weather Prediction — February 2026 in Malta
author: Admin
excerpt: A daily look at what the weather *might* be like in Malta during February — sunshine, breezes, and cool moments!
content:
This is a predicted daily weather pattern for February 2026 in Malta based on long‑term climate averages (weather can always change!). Each day lists what you *might* expect for kids and families out and about.

  • Feb 1: 🌤️ Mild and partly sunny, daytime ~15°C, cooler nights. Nice for a short walk along the promenade! ☀️
  • Feb 2: ☁️ Cloudy morning, sunshine in the afternoon. Light breeze and comfortable jacket weather. 🌬️
  • Feb 3: ☔ Chance of rain showers in the afternoon. Good day for indoor museums or craft time! 🎨
  • Feb 4: 🌦️ Mixed clouds and sunshine, a brief shower possible. Warm snack and jumpers are perfect! ☕
  • Feb 5: ☀️ Mostly sunny with mild temperatures — great day for sightseeing around Valletta. 🏛️
  • Feb 6: 🌤️ Sunshine with a few clouds — light breeze. Bring a hat for outdoor play! 👒
  • Feb 7: ☁️ Cloudy morning then clearer skies later. Ideal for a comfy day with friends. 🤗
  • Feb 8: ☔ Rain likely in the early afternoon. Perfect for reading and indoor games! 📚
  • Feb 9: 🌦️ Showers early, sunny breaks later — raincoat handy! ☂️
  • Feb 10: 🌤️ Mild sunshine, little wind — great for a family outing! 🚶‍♀️
  • Feb 11: ☁️ Cooler and cloudier, with possible light rain — ideal for indoor science experiments! 🔬
  • Feb 12: 🌤️ Sunshine in the afternoon; temperatures around 14–15°C. A perfect read‑a‑book‑outside day! 📖
  • Feb 13: ☀️ Mostly sunny and mild — good for exploring gardens or parks! 🌳
  • Feb 14: ☁️ More clouds with occasional sunshine. Great for family walks! 👣
  • Feb 15: ☔ A couple of showers expected — umbrellas ready! ☂️
  • Feb 16: 🌦️ Rain and sun mix — lots of puddles to jump in! 🌧️
  • Feb 17: 🌤️ Sunshine returns; mild and breezy. Outdoor fun! 🏃‍♂️
  • Feb 18: ☁️ Cloudy with some brightness — good day for baking at home! 🍪
  • Feb 19: ☀️ Sunny and calm — perfect for ice cream‑and‑walk day! 🍦
  • Feb 20: 🌤️ Partly sunny with light winds — nature walk day! 🌼
  • Feb 21: ☔ Scattered showers — time for board games inside! 🎲
  • Feb 22: 🌦️ A mix of showers and sunshine — dress in layers! 🧥
  • Feb 23: ☀️ Clear and mild — perfect for photos and picnics! 📸
  • Feb 24: 🌤️ Sunshine with a light breeze — visit a playground! 🛝
  • Feb 25: ☁️ Cloudy spells — a cozy book or movie night! 🎬
  • Feb 26: ☀️ Sun returns; mild and bright. Great day for a walk by the waterfront! 🌅
  • Feb 27: ☔ Chance of rain — colorful umbrellas are fun! 🌈
  • Feb 28: 🌤️ End of month with sunshine and cool breezes — wrap up February with outdoor fun! 🎉

This pattern is based on how February weather usually behaves in Malta: mild days around 15 °C, about 6 hours of sunshine daily, and rain showers spread through the month. Bring layers, a raincoat, and a smile! ☀️⛅☔
